remarks: Experience upscale urban living at The Classic in the heart of downtown Stamford! This luxurious one-bedroom, two-bath end unit offers 1,067 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space just steps from premier dining, shopping, theaters, and nightlife. Enjoy full-service amenities including a 24-hour concierge, newly renovated fitness center, pickle ball, penthouse-style clubroom, outdoor grills with a beautiful dog park, and a stunning rooftop pool and sundeck with panoramic views of the city skyline and Long Island Sound.  Inside, the open-concept layout features a modern kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, flowing seamlessly into a spacious living room. New luxury faux wood flooring adds warmth and style throughout much of the unit. The oversized balcony is accessible from the living room and provides a peaceful retreat with treetop views. The primary suite includes a private full bath, while a second full bath offers added convenience for guests. A reserved indoor garage space completes this exceptional offering. Enjoy sweeping city views, spectacular sunsets, and spirited nightscapes-welcome to the lifestyle you deserve at The Classic!
